changelog:
The television's "another phone" message, only when it is about you.

WHAT CHANGED

- MobileIPTV no longer says "Another phone is now using the television." when you open it while another phone is casting. The message now appears only when it was your own cast that another phone replaced.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.5.9: the phone's name on the television, up to eight phones per television, and the player name the phone sends.
